name: get_contact_info_schema
description:
Retrieve the contact-field schema required by a domain's TLD. Returns field requirements, not a registrant's personal information. Does not submit contact details or register a domain.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/registrar/domains/{domain}/contact-info/schema --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
